messages:
Marta: Acme reported their assistant suddenly adding fabricated invoice items. Ticket ACME-4521. They attached two example generations and say it started right after last night's deploy.

Jordan: Thanks, can you drop the examples here and the request-id so we can trace?

Marta: request-id: req_0a3b9f. Example: user asked for 'list invoice line items' and got extra vendor names and amounts that don't exist. Short snippets uploaded to ticket.

SupportBot: alert: config change detected - configs/global-sampling updated by priya (commit abc123). Affected cluster: hosted, region: eu-west1. Change time: 2026-11-02T09:15:12Z

Priya: That was me. I synced the canary sampling defaults to trunk during the rollout window because canary tests showed better throughput. I thought trunk was still using per-customer opt-ins. Sorry — looks like I pushed the defaults globally.

Ethan: Can you paste the applied diff? Need to confirm which sampling params flipped.

Priya: Applied snippet (before -> after):
```yaml
# BEFORE
sampling_default:
  temperature: 0.0
  top_p: 1.0
  top_k: 50

# AFTER
sampling_default:
  temperature: 0.6
  top_p: 0.9
  top_k: 40
```

Ethan: That's the smoking gun. Temperature 0.0 -> 0.6 explains the creativity and invented lines.

Marta: Acme is asking for an immediate rollback and a timeline. They flagged product and legal.

Jordan: Priya, can you revert to the previous commit (def456) and roll to hosted ASAP. Also preserve the current config for investigation.

Priya: Rolling back now to def456. Starting configmap revert job r-5012. ETA ~5m.

SupportBot: deployment: rollback started for configs/global-sampling (job r-5012). UI: https://console.redwood.dev/deployments/r-5012

Ethan: I'll run an A/B generation diff on the preserved pre- and post-change outputs. Want to quantify hallucination rate, token entropy, and any user-impacting regex hits (e.g., currency amounts).

Marta: Examples are saved to ACME-4521. I've redacted PII and looped legal. Customer message: "Please confirm rollback and let us know if our data was exposed."

Priya: Rollback complete. Current config shows:
```yaml
sampling_default:
  temperature: 0.0
  top_p: 1.0
  top_k: 50
```
Propagation reports show 100% of hosted nodes at desired config.

SupportBot: alert resolved: rollback completed for configs/global-sampling (job r-5012). Duration: 4m38s.

Ethan: Quick A/B: sampled 100 prompts. Post-change set (with temp=0.6) had +0.8 bits/token entropy and a 6.4% increase in hallucination-like tokens (currency/vendor insertion). CSV attached to ACME ticket.

Marta: Customer confirmed they see behavior returning to baseline. They're asking for a written postmortem and are requesting SLA credit for impacted sessions.

Jordan: Draft items for postmortem: timeline, root cause (operator synced canary defaults to trunk), why the change applied globally, mitigations taken (rollback), short-term fix (block global default changes without explicit opt-in), long-term fix (CI guard and console warning). Priya: open PR for a deployment guard that requires an explicit label to apply nonzero sampling defaults to trunk.

Priya: Will open PR and add a console banner/warning on sampling-default edits that affect trunk. I'll also add an env check to prevent accidental syncs from canary to trunk.

Jordan: Also include Ethan's metrics and the preserved examples in the customer-facing report. Marta, tell Acme ETA 48h for full write-up and offer to discuss SLA credit.

Marta: Sent rollback confirmation and 48h postmortem ETA. Customer asked for a brief technical summary in the next 2 hours — will draft and share for review.

Jordan: Good. Keep this thread updated. We'll escalate to Ops if anything else emerges.
